demos.name: Highland Tactics 3D
demos.description: True 3D terraced tactics: CT turns, height-aware paths, line of sight, facing bonuses and native surface/weather effects.

demos.description: Native WebGL floating islands, shaded architecture, fog, physics traversal, orbit/chase cameras and a skippable cinematic.
